title: Cheese Pizza, Whole Wheat Thick Crust

content.title: About
content.content: Cheese pizza on a whole wheat thick crust combines a fragrant tomato sauce, melted cheese, and a crunchy‑yet‑soft crust made from whole‑grain flour. This pizza is rich in carbohydrates, protein, and fiber, and also provides B‑vitamins and minerals from the whole grain.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Whole‑wheat crust contains more fiber and micronutrients than a traditional white crust.
Tomatoes in the sauce are a good source of lycopene, an antioxidant that supports heart health.
The cheese blend often includes mozzarella and cheddar, giving the pizza its characteristic stretch and flavor.
Pizza originated in Naples, but whole‑grain versions are now popular among health‑conscious consumers.

items.title: High in Fiber
items.content: Whole‑grain flour provides dietary fiber that aids digestion and promotes satiety.

items.title: Protein Source
items.content: Cheese and dough together deliver a substantial amount of animal and plant protein needed for tissue repair.

items.title: Lycopene and Antioxidants
items.content: The tomato sauce supplies lycopene, which may reduce the risk of cardiovascular disease.

items.title: B‑Vitamins
items.content: Whole‑wheat flour and cheese supply vitamins B1, B3, and B6, essential for energy metabolism.

items.title: Calcium
items.content: Cheese is a good source of calcium, supporting bone and dental health.

items.title: Milk Protein Allergy
items.content: Cheese can trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or milk protein allergy.

items.title: High Sodium Content
items.content: Cheese and sauce often contain a lot of salt, so people monitoring sodium intake should limit portions.

items.title: Caloric Density
items.content: The thick crust and cheese make the pizza energy‑dense; overconsumption may contribute to weight gain.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Whole‑wheat dough contains gluten, making it unsuitable for those with celiac disease.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Reheat the pizza in an oven at 180 °C for 5–7 minutes until the crust is crisp and the cheese is melty. Slice into portions and serve with a green salad or fresh vegetables.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the cooked pizza in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. For longer storage, freeze at –18 °C, then reheat in the oven before serving.
